desc: Read N and the list of coordinates X.
Use a priority queue to store potential operations (reduction amount and index i).
Loop while the priority queue is not empty:
Pop the operation with the largest reduction (most negative value).
Verify if the operation is still valid (i.e., the reduction amount matches the current state). If not, skip.
If valid, perform the operation: calculate new positions for the (i+1)-th and (i+2)-th pieces, update the array.
Re-evaluate and push to the priority queue any operations affected by the change (indices i-1, i, i+1).
Print the sum of the final coordinates.
Run the provided code against Sample 1 and Sample 2 to verify correctness.
Check edge cases (e.g., N=4, large coordinates).
